description: The approx. 4,000 attendance figure is one AFP-origin estimate via SWI; La Prensa and TVN confirm event/demands but not turnout. Independent crowd-count corroboration not found in three broad Spanish searches.

Searches covered CSS, labor, teachers, road closures and date windows; broad press results were dominated by unrelated periods. Local/provincial coverage and sectors outside CSS remain incomplete. No zero-event inference.
Official monthly baseline not located/checked in this first pass; baseline gate remains pending.
